channel.title: Academy of Management Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Academy of Management Journal (aom.org)

item.title: Stylist: 4 ways to overcome your fear of small talk at work, according to experts
item.description: As much as we might try to avoid it, small talk can benefit everyone involved. AMJ research cited in Stylist article.

item.title: Forbes: Research says star talent alone won’t save your team. But why?
item.description: Whether in Fortune 500 boardrooms or high-growth startups, leaders prize elite résumés and high-potential hire.

item.title: Inc: 50 Years Later, ‘Jaws’ (and Science) Proves How Embracing 1 Word Can Lead to Remarkable Success
item.description: As Spielberg proved, what you don’t have can actually be your competitive advantage—if you let it. AMJ research cited in Inc. article.

item.title: Seven Inducted Into AOM Fellows for 2025
item.description: The AOM Fellows Group provides opportunities for community and a forum for discussion among the people who have been recognized. For 2025, seven members were selected to be honored with induction.

item.title: Charter Works: What workers with autism need from workplaces
item.description: A research study in the Academy of Management Discoveries that uses interviews and survey data to explore the social challenges experienced by workers with ASD and their strategies for navigating these challenges.

item.title: Forbes: 3 Things The ‘Murdoch Succession’ Proves About Billion-Dollar Family Dynamics
item.description: Learning about the Murdoch succession through the lens of family psychology. Academy of Management Journal article referenced in Forbes.

item.title: Leading AOM into the Future: A Conversation with President Tammy L. Madsen
item.description: AOM President Tammy L. Madsen shares her reflections on leadership, her priorities for the year ahead, and her vision for AOM’s future.

item.title: Community Accelerator Program: Building Bridges
item.description: An initiative designed to expand access and strengthen engagement in historically underrepresented regions in the global academic community.

item.title: Advancing Connection, Collaboration, and Community Across Our Global Network
item.description: Guided by Vision 2030, AOM continues to strengthen access and engagement across its worldwide membership through a broad range of programs, events, and communities.

item.title: AACSB and AOM to Host Inaugural Research Impact Conference
item.description: AACSB and AOM will bring together global leaders in business education and management research for the inaugural Research Impact Conference
